title: Mordheim KB warband — equipment-access.yaml
description: The equipment lists a warband buys from at creation, with the prices printed for the warband. These costs are source data and are never replaced by the Trading Post prices of `catalog/campaign/`. Shared definitions live in defs.schema.json.

band_id.description: Band the lists belong to; must match the directory and `band.yaml`.

equipment_list.description: One list a profile buys from, referenced by `profiles.yaml` `equipment_lists`. It offers priced items, named loadouts, or both — never nothing.

items.description: Empty only when the list is made of loadouts alone (Pit Fighter styles).

loadouts.description: Named packages of the list (e.g. a chariot with its horses, or the fighting styles of a Pit Fighter).

equipment_entry.description: One purchasable line of a list.

cost.description: Creation price in gold crowns. Null when the source prices the item relative to another one (see `notes`), and a dice expression such as `25+1D6` when the price is rolled or the entry carries a rarity premium.

notes.description: Editorial note of the price, required whenever `cost` is not a plain integer.

price_override.description: Explicit exception to the collated price of `catalog/items/`, in gold crowns.

loadout.description: A named package of the list, priced as a whole.

items.description: Item ids of the package; an entry may instead offer a choice between options, and an option may bundle several items (`sword + sword`).

loadout_option.description: One alternative of a `choose_one`: a single item id, or the items of a bundled option.
